text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to watch Kawakami Princess take
a dance lesson from King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, King-san.
I'll be in your care for our dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your bow looks quite proper, doesn't it?
At this rate, dancing should be—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I come!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a secooond!
Just what do you think you're doing!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think? Dance practice,
of course."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King-san told me that to dance beautifully, you need the muscle strength to maintain your posture♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, if you're not messing around,
that just makes it harder to scold you!
choice_data_list: For now, let's hold off on throwing punches.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right!
Dancing isn't about beating people up, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? T-Then what should I do...っ!?
choice_data_list: How about trying to dance together or something?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I see! Leg strength over arm strength! Kicks over punches!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's wrong, dummy!
Not a kick, a S-T-E-P!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Step! Like this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Not yet! If you're aiming to be first-class, focus your awareness all the way down to your toes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Understood! I shall do this with enough force to punch right through the floorboards! Hmph! Hyah!
Thanks to her strict master's guidance, Kawakami Princess's dance gained an incredible presence!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, I'm so delighted! King-san, your dancing
always leaves me completely enchanted!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there watching—dance, come on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Right now,
I'm dancing with King-san, whom I've always looked up to—!
(Swish! Swoosh!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... S-Stop!
STOOOOOOP!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're way too worked up!
Your punch has just as much force behind it as the last one!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-That is strange, is it not...? I thought I was dancing normally.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive you if you hit me, got it?
...Whatever you do, do NOT hit me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course!
Rest assured!
Thanks to King Halo's meticulous guidance that followed, Kawakami Princess's dancing was polished to perfection.
